name: NGAL Fast Test Kit
shortDescription: Quantitative determination of NGAL using the DX 101 Immunofluorescence Quantitative Analyzer.
intendedUse: quantitative determination of neutrophils gelatinase associated lipocalin (NGAL) in human serum and urine samples. This test is used as an aid in the early diagnosis of acute kidney injury (AKl), risk classification and treatment monitoring. For professional and laboratory use only.
